members.title: Judge rules Trump-appointed US prosecutor in Los Angeles is not serving legally – US politics live
members.lead: Trump, citing New York Times report, says Mary Peltola’s actions to recruit a second Dan Sullivan ‘illegal’ and calls for her disqualification from US Senate race Peltola’s campaign reportedly recruited second Dan Sullivan in Alaska Senate race Sign up for the Breaking News US email For months, Mary Peltola’s campaign for Alaska’s Senate seat has denied any connection to a separate campaign launched by a man who, coincidentally, shares the exact same name as Peltola’s Republican opponent, Dan Sullivan. New reporting from the New York Times undercuts that claim. The outlet reported, based on interviews, obtained text messages and legal filings, that the Peltola campaign had not only recruited Mr Sullivan (not the Republican), but had sought out a number of Dan Sullivans across the state for potential candidacy, as well as others who could peel votes away from Peltola’s main opponent. members.title: Democrat Mary Peltola’s campaign reportedly recruited second Dan Sullivan in Alaska Senate race
members.lead: Republicans have condemned the presence of two Dan Sullivans on the ballot, calling it a ploy to split votes Alaska Democrat Mary Peltola’s campaign was behind an effort to recruit a challenger with almost the exact same name as the Republican US senator Dan Sullivan, both of whom will appear on the ballot in next week’s midterm elections, the New York Times reported on Wednesday. Republicans have condemned the presence in the race of two candidates named Dan Sullivan – one the two-term US senator, the second a retiree living in south-eastern Alaska with scant political experience – calling the newcomer a ploy by Democrats to cost the incumbent re-election by splitting his supporters.
